body:
Industrial Multi-Effect Evaporation System Project

This project features an integrated multi-effect evaporation system developed for industrial wastewater treatment, liquid concentration, and resource recovery.

Tongyang played a significant role throughout the project, contributing to engineering coordination, customized process equipment solutions, manufacturing support, and project implementation.

The system incorporates multi-stage evaporation technology, external heating units, vapor-liquid separation, and heat recovery arrangements to improve thermal efficiency and reduce energy consumption.

Through close collaboration with project engineering and technical teams, Tongyang supported equipment-related technical requirements, manufacturing coordination, and overall system integration.

The project demonstrates Tongyang's extensive involvement in industrial process engineering and complex equipment projects, particularly in chemical processing, environmental protection, and wastewater treatment applications.
